rundown: Broncos beat Eagles 34-27 at Waldo Stadium in Kalamazoo, MI. Broncos led 31-7 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Broncos won it 17-0. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 87%).
Scoring: Eagles 4 touchdowns and 0 field goals; Broncos 4 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: A. Blue run for 1 yd, for a TD (R. Kessinger KICK) (4th quarter, 7:36).

Leading the way — Eagles: Brogan McCaughey 12/16, 135 yds, 1 TD; Amareon Blue 27 car, 160 yds, 3 TD; Nick Devereaux 4 rec, 62 yds. Broncos: Broc Lowry 12/18, 106 yds; Jalen Buckley 20 car, 140 yds, 2 TD; Adam Parks 3 rec, 34 yds.
Where Broncos won it: they outgained them 341 yards to 330 and held the ball 31:42 to 28:18.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Broncos closed as 18.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Eagles +18.5 cashed); the total closed at 45.5 and they combined for 61, over by 15.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 17, 5:58 PM ET. It had Eagles 15% and Broncos 85%, projecting Eagles 17.4 – Broncos 33.4 (50.8 total, Broncos by 16).

Final: Eagles 27 – Broncos 34. Right winner: it had Broncos at 85%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Eagles came in with a 31% below average attack and a 31% leakier than average defense (4-6, 19.9 scored and 26.6 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 174 and 171 games of evidence. Projected to score 17.4, they scored 27 (+9.6 points, 55% over); projected to allow 33.4, they allowed 34 (+0.6 points, 2% over).

Broncos came in with a 5% below average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (7-3, 27.8 scored and 18.7 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 177 and 171 games of evidence. Projected to score 33.4, they scored 34 (+0.6 points, 2% over); projected to allow 17.4, they allowed 27 (+9.6 points, 55% over).

The bigger miss was Eagles' scoring (+9.6 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 61 against 50.8 projected (+10.2), about the 74th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Broncos by 7 against Broncos by 16 projected, about the 28th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Broncos ×1.02, Eagles ×1.00. It favored Broncos, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.body:

UNDER 45.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Broncos -17.5 → -18.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 37% of bets on Eagles, 33% of the money — Eagles covered; total: 54% of bets on the over, 66% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 4% of bets on Eagles, 9% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Broncos, who won and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.126 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.2 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 131 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.3 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
